note — the bold part is what the card te: sechs drops its s before -zig: sechzig, as in sechzehn.
sieben drops its -en: siebzig, as in siebzehn.
acht + zig, nothing dropped.
neun + zig: neunzig.
hundert needs no word for a; einhundert is also possible.
The unit, und, the ten: fünfundsechzig.
neun und neunzig, in one word.
The unit keeps its full form, siebenund-; only the ten shortens to siebzig.
zwei und achtzig: two-and-eighty.
acht und zwanzig. Months take der, so der Februar.
im before a month: im Januar. The months are all der-words.
im Februar: in February.
im März takes the first place; the verb follows.
im April: the verb second, ich after it.
im Mai.

English: **In June** we play a lot of football.
note — the bold part is what the card te: im Juni.
im Juli. Juni and Juli sound alike; on the phone people say Juno and Julei.
im August, stressed on the second syllable: Au-GUST.
im September: a time phrase goes before the object.
der Oktober. einunddreißig: one-and-thirty.

English: **In November** I drink a lot of tea.
note — the bold part is what the card te: im November.

English: **In December** we eat a lot of cake.
note — the bold part is what the card te: im Dezember.
der Monat → Monate, the -e plural.
Dates use ordinals: erste, first. German says the first May, with no of.

English: **On the second** of January I'm working.
note — the bold part is what the card te: After am the ordinal ends in -en: am zweiten.

English: My birthday is **on the third** of June.
note — the bold part is what the card te: dritte is irregular, like English third: am dritten.
Up to 19, the ordinal adds -t-: vier → vierte.

English: When is your birthday? (one friend) – **On the fourth** of August.
German: Wann ist dein Geburtstag? – **Am vierten** August.
note — the bold part is what the card te: am vierten: -ten after am.

English: **On the seventh** of July my brother is coming.
note — the bold part is what the card te: sieben drops -en: siebte, am siebten.

English: **On the tenth** of December we're cooking.
note — the bold part is what the card te: zehn + -t-: am zehnten.
From 20 on, the ordinal adds -st-: zwanzigste.

English: **On the thirty-first** of December we eat fish.
note — the bold part is what the card te: From 20 on, -st-: einunddreißigsten.

English: Is your birthday **on the first** of April? (one friend)
note — the bold part is what the card te: erste is irregular: am ersten, never einsten.
der dritte: after der, the ordinal ends in -e.
The month can be left out when it is clear: der siebte.
